**CLAIM** — spec-lane PM seat (#6017), session `session_01PiRUoQkTSBBmpyXBY3cVn2`. Branch: `claude/issue-7294-declare-publish-response`. Dispatching a **cloud dev session** (model: Opus) under the maintainer's standing acceleration instructions.

Direction: mirror the #5745 discipline one door over, exactly as the card lays out — the publish door gets the same three artifacts the save door has: (1) `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` declaring the full measured body (`success`/`version`/`seq`/`message` + conditional `seedApplied`/`materializeApplied`/`projectionApplied`, from `protocol.ts:9771-9798`); (2) the endpoint declaration in `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts` (`POST {metaPath}/:type/:name/publish`, `handler: 'publishMetaItem'`, `responseSchema` reference), matching the 6 existing metadata-category entries' shape; (3) a producer-side conformance gate mirroring `save-meta-response-conformance.test.ts` including its header discipline. Premise-first: re-measure that the route is still served and still undeclared. New public exports expected ⇒ dual-snapshot rule in full.
